Name: JP's Le Pets - Monsters of the Mines
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6]
[color=#ff00ff][u][center]Monster Pets[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b]Adds most of the monsters found in the mines as a peaceful version of the same, all available for adoption directly from Marnie's Ranch.[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Most of the monsters in the mines (See below). For now only the normal monsters and not their dangerous mine variations.[/size]
[*][size=4]New animations for all monsters including Sleeping or Special animations performing any activity.[/size]
[*][size=4]Each pet has its respective sounds when petted or when they emit a random sound. [/size]
[*][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]All can be obtained at Marnie's Ranch for 5000 gold.[/color] You can also select one of these pets when creating a new character.[/size][/b]
[*][size=4]From a relationship with your pets greater than 1 heart, there is a daily probability of 30% to 40% that they will give you a gift when you pet them. The more hearts, the better the gifts. [b][color=#00ff00]The gifts will be related to what these monsters would give in the mines. (Slime from small Slimes, Slime Eggs from big Slimes, Void Essence from Shadow Brutes, etc). [/color][color=#ffff00]The most valuable gifts are less likely to be obtained than others that are much more common.[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=4]You must configure the mod to choose which monsters you want to appear in the catalog (This is to avoid crowding of options in the catalog).[/size]
[*][b][i][color=#ff0000][size=4]Remember to buy a pet bowl from Robin's store for each pet you adopt or they will get angry and won't leave the house.[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/list][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/color][b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6][u]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][b][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#f4f4f4]Reach [/color][color=#ff00ff]5 hearts[/color][color=#f4f4f4] with the pet Marnie finds.[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b] wait until [color=#00ffff]day 2 of year 2[/color] to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][list=1]
